title: Lean like the coach at the middle and bottom (judge by the picture, like the coach)

log.text: The start now matches. At the middle and bottom he still looks more upright than the coach: read from the picture with the same detector as the coach, his lean is 12° and 10° against the coach's 18° and 22°. Making the Studio judge by the picture and the animation aim for it.
Started: reading the brief, the solver and the Studio's measuring code before changing anything.

Measured the cause: on the picture the detector puts our shoulders near the neck and slides them back toward the bar as he squats, so his trunk reads 11° at the bottom while the bones say 22°. Tipping his chest forward moves the picture reading almost one for one, so the animation can aim at the picture.

Built the Studio side (ours read from the picture like the coach, the bones as a cross-check) and a solver loop that reads the picture and corrects the lean; a trial on the last run's scene brings the picture lean to 8 / 20 / 27° against the coach's 7 / 18 / 22. Now running a full test run on a scratch copy.

First full test run: the grip now passes (1.80 against the coach's 1.87, was 1.67); no bar height keeps the grip, the wrists and the standing upper arm all in tolerance, so as ruled the grip is kept and the standing upper arm reads 51° against 41°. At the bottom the picture can't give both the coach's lean and hip angle without sinking the hips below the knees, so the lean comes first; running the second test now.

Second test run: the picture now reads his lean 8 / 18 / 22° against the coach's 7 / 18 / 22°; the bottom's hip angle reads 79° against 69° because holding the hips at the coach's depth is kept. Applied the changes to the Studio and the animation code; running the final checks and one more full test.

Final checks pass on a full test run with the applied code: the picture reads his lean 8 / 18 / 22° against the coach's 7 / 18 / 22° (all three pass); the bottom's hip angle reads 79° against 69° (shown as uncertain: the picture and the skeleton read it 24° apart); the grip passes and, as ruled, the standing upper arm gives way to it. Closing now; the Studio will re-run the squat.

summary: Picture lean 8 / 12 / 11° → 8 / 18 / 22° (coach 7 / 18 / 22): he now leans like the coach at the middle and bottom. Bottom hip angle 97° → 79° (coach 69°): closer, but matching it would sink his hips below his knees, so the depth is kept. Grip 1.67 → 1.79 (passes); the standing upper arm gives way to it (45° → 51°, coach 41°).
